primary_user_goal: Understand Typeform's value proposition and sign up to create forms
primary_business_goal: Convert visitors to registered users with clear differentiation from traditional form tools
copy_summary: Hero emphasizes 'forms worth filling out' - focusing on respondent experience rather than builder features. Tagline 'Break the pattern' differentiates from boring traditional forms. Social proof shows trusted brands and completion rate statistics.
notes: Landing page immediately demonstrates the product through embedded, interactive form examples. The messaging inverts traditional form tool positioning - instead of 'build forms easily,' it promises 'forms people actually complete.' Completion rate statistics (3x higher than industry average) serve as compelling proof points.

primary_user_goal: Find a suitable form template for specific use case
primary_business_goal: Accelerate time-to-value by providing pre-built starting points
copy_summary: Templates organized by use case (feedback, registration, quiz, lead gen). Each template card shows preview, response count from community usage, and complexity indicator. Categories use plain language not form jargon.
notes: Template gallery is organized around jobs-to-be-done, not form types. 'Customer feedback survey' instead of 'Multi-question form with rating scales.' Template previews show the actual form experience, not just a static screenshot. This lets users experience Typeform's differentiating UX before committing.

primary_user_goal: Build or customize form structure by adding and arranging questions
primary_business_goal: Enable rapid form creation while exposing upgrade-worthy features
copy_summary: Builder interface shows question list as outline on left, with question editing in center. Question types are visually represented with clear icons. Helper text guides users on question configuration.
notes: Form builder prioritizes seeing the form as respondents will see it. The 'Create' view closely mirrors the 'Fill' experience, helping builders understand how their form feels. Question types are discoverable through a visual panel with examples. Drag-and-drop reordering feels natural. Auto-save removes anxiety about losing work.

primary_user_goal: Configure individual question text, type, options, and settings
primary_business_goal: Provide flexibility while maintaining conversational form aesthetic
copy_summary: Question editor shows exactly how question will appear. Placeholder text suggests conversational phrasing. Settings revealed progressively - basics visible, advanced options in panels.
notes: Question editor is where Typeform's philosophy shines. Default placeholder text uses conversational tone ('What's your name?' not 'Enter name'). The editor shows exactly how the question appears to respondents - WYSIWYG editing. Required/optional toggles, descriptions, and media are all progressive disclosure - there when needed, hidden when not.

primary_user_goal: Create conditional paths based on respondent answers
primary_business_goal: Differentiate from basic form tools; drive upgrades for logic features
copy_summary: Logic interface visualizes form as branching paths. Conditions are expressed in plain language ('If answer is X, then jump to Y'). Visual flowchart shows how respondents will navigate.
notes: Logic branching is a key differentiator and premium feature. The visual flowchart makes complex logic understandable. Conditions use natural language ('If this answer contains...') not programming syntax. Preview with logic lets builders test paths without publishing. This feature alone justifies upgrade for many users creating sophisticated surveys.

primary_user_goal: Customize form appearance to match brand or preferences
primary_business_goal: Enable brand consistency; gate full customization to paid plans
copy_summary: Theme panel shows preset themes with live preview. Color controls allow primary color selection with automatic complementary colors. Font choices curated for readability in conversational format.
notes: Themes are a major Typeform differentiator - forms can be beautiful, not just functional. Preset themes cover diverse aesthetics from minimal to bold. Live preview shows changes instantly. Custom themes (save your brand colors, fonts) are a compelling upgrade trigger. Background images/videos transform forms into immersive experiences.

primary_user_goal: Distribute form to target audience through preferred channel
primary_business_goal: Maximize form distribution to drive response volume
copy_summary: Share panel provides multiple distribution options with one-click copy. Embed options include full-page, popup, slider, and popover. Custom URL available on paid plans.
notes: Share screen recognizes that forms are distributed many ways. Direct link is default and easiest. Embed options include multiple formats - full-page takeover, corner popup, slider from side. Each embed type shows preview of how it appears. QR code generation is built-in for offline-to-online use cases. Access controls (password, close date) available for gated forms.

primary_user_goal: Analyze form responses and extract insights
primary_business_goal: Demonstrate value of collected data; drive upgrades for advanced analytics
copy_summary: Results dashboard shows response count, completion rate, average time. Each question shows aggregated data with appropriate visualization (charts for multiple choice, word clouds for text). Drop-off analysis shows where respondents abandon.
notes: Results page goes beyond raw data to provide insights. Completion rate prominently displayed - reinforces Typeform's value prop. Question-by-question breakdown uses appropriate charts. Drop-off analysis (premium) shows exactly where respondents abandon - actionable for optimization. Individual response view enables qualitative analysis. Export to CSV/Excel for external analysis.

primary_user_goal: Understand pricing tiers and select appropriate plan
primary_business_goal: Convert free users to paid subscribers with clear value articulation
copy_summary: Plans positioned by response volume and features. Logic, branding, and advanced analytics clearly marked per tier. Annual discount highlighted. Free tier shown as legitimate starting point.
notes: Pricing page clearly differentiates tiers by response limits and feature access. Logic jumps, calculator, and hidden fields are clear upgrade triggers. The 'Plus' tier is visually recommended for most users. Free tier is presented honestly - good for trying but limited. Feature comparison table is scannable. FAQ addresses common objections.

primary_user_goal: Complete form efficiently while feeling engaged rather than burdened
primary_business_goal: Maximize completion rates and quality of responses
copy_summary: Single question displayed full-screen. Question text is large and conversational. Answer options are keyboard-navigable. Progress indicator shows completion percentage. Smooth animations between questions create flow state.
notes: This is Typeform's core innovation - the respondent experience. One question at a time eliminates visual overwhelm. Full-screen display commands attention. Keyboard navigation (Enter to continue, up/down for options) creates flow. Progress bar reduces abandonment anxiety. Transitions between questions are smooth and satisfying. The experience feels like a conversation, not a form.
